summary: Three vegan students—a high schooler, a college student, and a medical student—present a day of meals highlighting practical plant-based cooking and time-saving techniques. The breakfast segment features tofu and hummus toast pressed tofu, a Mexican tofu scramble, and vegan chocolate chip protein pancakes. Lunch centers on a pesto pasta and a winter citrus arugula salad, with reflection on cafeteria options and protein needs. Dinner showcases variations including a tofu and quinoa bowl, a Thai red curry with peanut sauce, and a pasta with cashew-cream sauce and seitan, underscoring how to build flavorful meals with accessible ingredients. Throughout the video, the speakers discuss prep strategies (soaking beans, cashew crema), cultural food influences, and the motivation behind vegan choices (climate justice, accessibility), offering a practical, multi-meal template for vegan students balancing school and studies.
